mentions.name: jsonmaps.dev
mentions.description: This tool lets developers create maps and storytelling maps that can be embedded in React applications, with story maps defined as chapters with camera views and content that handle scroll-driven camera interpolation. It is built on MapLibre, uses React, and is published as an npm package.
mentions.problem: AI tools were unable to generate reliable maps in applications: every map library has its own imperative API, and AI output was often broken, hallucinated, or unmaintainable due to the many different formats that can be put on a map.
mentions.audience: React application developers who want reliable, declarative map generation
mentions.source_excerpt: jsonmaps.dev its a way to create maps and create storytelling maps that you can embed in your react application, I was quite tired of how AI wasn't able to generate reliable maps in my applications.
